articles.title: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
articles.snippet: The 12-month test will put a beta version of the central bank currency through online, mobile, in-store and peer-to-peer payments.

articles.title: Why banks should stop worrying and learn to love the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: They could be the biggest winners from regulatory clarity, argues Alex Tapscott, CEO of CMCC Global Capital Markets.

articles.title: Strive adds 469 Bitcoin to reach 25,000 BTC treasury
articles.snippet: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase was funded entirely through its SATA preferred stock as the company continues its rapid climb among corporate BTC holders.

articles.title: 'It's Now or Never' for Clarity Act, Says 'Bitcoin Senator' Lummis
articles.snippet: The Wyoming Republican says the final text hands Democrats more than 120 of their own demands, including sweeping new ethics rules, as the Senate holds a make-or-break cloture vote Tuesday afternoon.

articles.title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Dev Corp Rolls Out $300M CHAD to Buy More SOL
articles.snippet: DeFi Development Corp added another 55,491 SOL and opened a CHAD at-the-market program for its preferred stock, extending a fast-moving three-week run of capital markets activity.
